primitives.note: Q, E, R each deal a single (or fixed-delay) burst of magic damage on cast, on cooldown, gated by mana cost and cast time
Q (55), E (70-90), R (100) mana costs can meaningfully limit how many casts fit in a 15s window at low mana pools/levels

If Q or E hits a Seed, it sprouts into a Thorn Spitter (ranged, Q) or Vine Lasher (melee, E) that lives 8s and attacks independently, adding separate damage instances not tied to Zyra's own attack/cast timers

W plants Seeds from a 2-charge stock with a per-rank recharge timer (18s to 10s); Seeds are the resource that Q/E consume to spawn plants, and P also passively stocks Seeds on its own (level-scaled) timer up to an 8-Seed cap
Passive Seed spawn cadence scales by champion level (13.6s at low level down to 9.05s at 18), changing how many Seeds/plants are available to convert during the fight

R's enrage effect on plants caught in its radius grants them +50% current HP heal, +50% max HP, and a flurry (extra shots) for 10s -- a temporary buff that raises the damage/survivability of the pet entities, not of Zyra herself

needsBespoke.why: Zyra's real damage output over 15s depends on a Seed economy that the primitive list does not directly model: Seeds are produced by two separate sources (P's level-scaled passive timer, W's 2-charge active with its own recharge), capped at 8 total, and only become damage-dealing entities (Thorn Spitter/Vine Lasher pets) if Q or E happens to hit one. Those pets then attack autonomously for 8s with their own damage, and R can retroactively buff any pets inside its radius (heal, +50% max HP, double-strike flurry) for 10s. Modeling this faithfully requires bespoke seed-inventory/pet-lifecycle logic layered on top of pet-or-summon and weapon-or-ammo-system, plus a rule for whether/how R's flurry buff is applied to already-spawned pets in the dummy fight.

Pets are out of scope for the dummy fight and only Q/E's direct impact damage is counted

Cast Grasping Roots (E) into a placed Seed to pop it into a Vine Lasher, and Deadly Spines (Q) into the other placed Seed to pop it into a Thorn Spitter, landing E and Q's own impact damage on the dummy at the same time.
